high: Research provenance is semantically inaccurate for several normalized_mechanics assignments. Return of the Obra Dinn has fixed factual solutions and no placement optimization, yet cites multiple_valid_solutions and spatial_optimization. PowerWash Simulator has tool-choice tradeoffs but no scarce-resource allocation or associated failure state, so resource_tradeoff does not match the library definition.
medium: Return of the Obra Dinn's sequencing_dependency attribution is weak: the corpus describes reconstructing a timeline, not designing or executing an order with dependency-based failure as defined by the library.

job-mechanics-map.json says to always add variable_conditions or multiple_valid_solutions, although the library itself identifies cases where multiple_valid_solutions is unsuitable and some challenges legitimately have fixed solutions. This guidance may produce unjustified modifiers.
low: Papers, Please as evidence for spatial_optimization is borderline: desk organization affects efficiency, but it is not the position/adjacency/path optimization described by the mechanic's primary definition.
evidence: factory/taxonomy/mechanics-library.json — 22 entries; every entry contains all required fields, all IDs are snake_case and unique, and layers are limited to challenge, modifier, and motivation.
factory/taxonomy/mechanics-library.json — motivation entries explicitly state that they do not substitute for challenge mechanics.
factory/lab/research/games.json — all 15 games' normalized_mechanics reference existing library IDs.

factory/lab/research/games.json — Return of the Obra Dinn is described as resolving fixed identities and causes; this does not substantiate multiple valid accepted solutions or player-controlled spatial placement.

factory/lab/research/games.json — PowerWash Simulator describes unlimited, persistent low-penalty cleaning with nozzle width/power choices, not allocation of a scarce resource whose imbalance causes failure.
factory/taxonomy/job-mechanics-map.json — all mapped mechanic IDs exist, and forward/reverse spot-checks agree with suitable_job_difficulties.
factory/lab/job-difficulty-taxonomy.md — all 14 mapping keys correspond to defined difficulty IDs, with no missing difficulty mappings.
factory/taxonomy/mechanics-taxonomy.md — the original 16 operation-layer interaction patterns remain present and documented.

factory/taxonomy/mechanics-library.json — collectively covers the requested dominant structures, including limited attempts, time pressure, partial information, dynamic state, tradeoffs, sequencing, spatial optimization, risk/reward, delayed feedback, uncertainty, combination search, prioritization, modifiers, and long-term motivations.
recommended_actions: Remove or replace Return of the Obra Dinn provenance for multiple_valid_solutions and spatial_optimization; reconsider sequencing_dependency against its exact definition.
Remove PowerWash Simulator from resource_tradeoff or broaden/rename that mechanic only if capability tradeoffs are intentionally in scope without scarcity or allocation.
Change the map guidance from always adding one of the two modifiers to adding one only when supported by the job difficulty and solution structure.
Clarify whether workspace organization qualifies as spatial_optimization; otherwise remove Papers, Please from that evidence list.
